stories.title: ProvidusUnity Bank Pioneers Mastercard Payments on Google Pay, Building on Its 2021 Tokenisation Innovation
stories.summary: ProvidusUnity Bank has enabled eligible customers to use their Mastercard cards on Google Pay, expanding payment options through compatible mobile devices. The development builds on the Bank’s early investment in tokenisation and its focus on secure, convenient digital payments.

stories.title: AU should take up issue of African recruits to Russia, says Kenya foreign minister
stories.summary: Foreign minister Musalia Mudavadi has admitted that Kenya doesn’t know how many of its citizens were recruited by Russia to fight in Ukraine, but says the matter should be taken up by the African Union.

stories.title: Paystack’s Akinlade puts business infrastructure at centre of next growth phase
